task.title: Try the leak test
task.shortdesc: Put an authority-only key into an evidence topic in your sandbox, and watch check_consistency block the public and downstream packs.

context.p: The authority-only keys hold placeholders, not real figures. In a real source they would hold facts that only the AI Office may receive, such as training compute.

step.cmd: Under Leak test, choose a topic and an authority-only key.
Pick the Public or Downstream provider reader.

info.p: The status becomes Release blocked and the build is turned off. The authority pack isn't blocked, because it may contain authority-only keys.

step.cmd: Select Remove it to end the test.
